title: Basin-lake spring breeding pulse
scope: Qualitative productivity and overlapping spring breeding migrations in Project Hearthway's initial freshwater basin lake. Exact organisms, anatomy, quantities, route mechanisms, fisheries, Mana, progression, and cultural interpretation remain open.
approval_evidence: Across guided ecology questions on 2026-08-14, the Author selected a broadly productive but spatially and seasonally varied lake; proposed overlapping mass-breeding and family-care migrants; approved their juvenile predator-prey relationship and competition with resident fauna plus exploitation by humans and fishing land and bird-like organisms; and replied 'yes' to the spring-freshet sequence, one-warm-season rearing cycle, and the presented recommendation for dense ribbons or clusters of eggs deposited onto sturdy plants and mineral surfaces across dispersed nursery belts.
question: What qualitative lake-productivity and breeding-migration relationship should anchor the first aquatic fauna-family development?
selection: Use LAKE-MIGRATION-D. The freshwater through-flow lake is biologically productive but varies spatially and seasonally. Spring freshet creates favourable passage from the sea and marks the start of rising lake productivity. An unnamed mass-breeding migrant arrives first and deposits dense ribbons or clusters of eggs onto sturdy plants and mineral surfaces across several nursery habitat classes. Healthy adults generally return seaward despite meaningful mortality across the cycle. A distinct family-care migrant follows, remains through one warm season while rearing young, and escorts surviving young seaward before autumn storms and first freezes. Its young consume the first migrant's eggs and juveniles as an important but non-exclusive food source. Both migrants compete with resident lake fauna, while humans and aquatic, terrestrial shore-hunting, and bird-like fishing organisms exploit the abundance. Reproductive risk is dispersed across places and times so that no single ordinary predator, flood, or fishery routinely destroys the entire generation; exceptional or compound recruitment failure remains possible. The dispersed egg-deposition pattern creates feeding grounds that shift across the lake over the season.
alternatives: LAKE-MIGRATION-A: a littoral-limited lake supporting one short mass-breeding run; not selected.
LAKE-MIGRATION-B: a broadly productive lake with only the mass-breeding migrant selected; not selected.
LAKE-MIGRATION-C: a broadly productive lake with only the family-care migrant selected; not selected.
LAKE-MIGRATION-D: a broadly productive spatial and seasonal mosaic with overlapping mass-breeding and family-care migrants; selected.
rationale: The selected package gives the large lake an extended, observable seasonal ecology without making it the basin's sole engine. Offset migrations connect passage, egg deposition, juvenile feeding, resident competition, predator concentration, and human exploitation while preserving later freedom to design two original animal families and test their quantitative population budgets.
evidence: Author direction on 2026-08-14: 'i'm happy for the lake as a whole to be productive but for different flora/fauna to prefer different areas leading to seasonal variance'.
Author direction on 2026-08-14 proposing a mass-breeding migrant and a family-care migrant in the same seasonal cycle.
Author selection on 2026-08-14: 'yes + they are both competing with the local fauna that exist their all year around and the local humans and land animals /birds-like that 'fish''.
Subsequent Author 'yes' selections on 2026-08-14 for the spring-freshet sequence, one-warm-season rearing cycle, and dispersed egg-ribbon nursery pattern.

The final Author 'yes' directly answered the presented recommendation that the first migrant deposit dense egg ribbons or clusters onto sturdy plants and mineral surfaces across dispersed nursery belts, preventing one ordinary predator, flood, or fishery from destroying the entire generation.
consequences: The lake is broadly productive while remaining spatially and seasonally heterogeneous.
Spring freshet supplies a qualitative passage window and coincides with the start of rising lake productivity; its exact mechanism and timing remain open.
River-mouth shallows, protected bays, submerged ridges, and flooded vegetation margins exist as qualitative egg-deposition and nursery habitat classes.
Flooded vegetation is not identified as the reserve-web guild or any other named flora.
Egg ribbons describe egg arrangement only and establish no ribbon-shaped animal, Lineage II relationship, or approved body plan.
Egg deposition onto sturdy plants and mineral surfaces establishes no adhesion, entanglement, draping, anchoring, or other retention mechanism.
The dispersed egg-deposition pattern creates feeding grounds that shift across the lake over the season; exact locations, timing, consumers, and movement remain open.
Humans participate as a mortality channel without establishing fishing technology, law, trade, ritual, or sustainable harvest.
No single ordinary predator, flood, or fishery routinely destroys the entire generation; this establishes no sustainable harvest rate and does not prevent exceptional or compound collapse.

Biological breeding, migration, hatching, mortality, and recruitment are ordinary variable ecology, not System spawning, reset, refill, pooled identity, pooled progression, or automatic reward transfer.
residual_unknowns: Names, taxonomy, ancestry, anatomy, body plans, sizes, cognition, lifespan, and senses remain open.
Exact sea range, route, salinity transition, passage barriers, swimming ability, navigation, timing, triggers, duration, and population scale remain open.
Egg construction, fertilisation, fecundity, synchrony, hatching time, and nursery densities remain open.
Egg retention and the exact placement mechanism on sturdy plants and mineral surfaces remain open.
Adult repeat breeding, mortality cause and rate, and return fidelity remain open.
Family-care reproductive mode, carers, family size, and exact care behaviours remain open.
Adult diets, juvenile dietary proportions, resident competitors, predators, disease, parasites, nutrient transfers, carrying capacity, and recruitment budgets remain open.
Human techniques, knowledge, access, ownership, law, trade, ritual, preservation, and harvest scale remain open.
Mana organs, specialised abilities, System templates, formal Skills, levels, and appraisal remain open.
The later body-plan recommendation was not selected and has no authority.
reopening_conditions: Later route hydraulics cannot support the selected seasonal passage.
The timing of egg availability and family-care juvenile demand cannot overlap plausibly.
A later recruitment and mortality budget cannot sustain both populations under the selected predation and harvest pressures.
A later accepted organism, geography, ecology, culture, or story record creates a concrete contradiction.
The Author explicitly reopens the decision.
